svg.title: Architectural drawing
svg.desc: Elevation of a terrace balustrade: three bays of vase-shaped balusters between a base rail and a top rail, divided by pedestals, with a round close-up of two balusters showing their profile, the spacing and the rails. Source: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.
svg.text: SOURCE: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric construction of this form; no external drawing
